title: Camera-wrapped background grid
description: 32-screen-unit cells, row-major submission at the farthest ordering slot over black. Horizontal wrap is 1024 screen units. Room/event camera angles, Q12 parallax and offsets remain room state, not image depth. Semantic background identities remain unresolved under #210; background.import.* is explicitly compatibility-only.

image_id.description: Authoritative native image reference, resolved through the conversion manifest (including aliases). The selected image must satisfy the background sampler/material contract; it need not be the original paired TIM.

cells.description: Exactly columns * rows cells; runtime validates this cross-field constraint.

image_source.description: Original paired image import provenance, not the live image selector.

unused_header_word.description: FAR +8, unconsumed by the background reader. Retained exactly, not an authoring quantity.

color.description: RGB texture modulation in 1/128 units: 128 neutral, 0 black.

source_texels.description: Inclusive sampled texel endpoints; right < left or bottom < top mirrors. Both pairs equal means disabled. Endpoints must be inside the bound image. Original signed delta is endpoint minus start, not pixel count.

unused_corner_bytes.description: Unconsumed CVECTOR code bytes for top-left, bottom-left, bottom-right. Top-right code is represented by image_depth.
